subject: Dedicated capacity sizing follow-up: GPU type, TPS targets, concurrency, token mix
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up & sizing questions from today's call (Dedicated capacity)

Hi Samantha,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great discussion. Per our conversation, I wanted to capture a few follow-up questions so Marissa/Rafael and I can size Dedicated capacity and recommend a GPU/configuration and pricing that match your workload. If you can reply inline that would be perfect.

High-level items we need:
- Preferred GPU family: H100 (preferred) vs A100 (if H100 not available)
- TPS target (sustained requests per second) and expected peak TPS (e.g., sustained 50 TPS, peak 200 TPS)
- Concurrent active requests (avg concurrent generation jobs)
- Token mix: average input tokens, average generated tokens, and % of requests that are long-form (>=1024 tokens)
- Request type breakdown: % text generation vs % embeddings vs % reranking
- Model(s) you expect to serve (if any) or open to Redwood recommendations
- Region preference and timeline for deployment (target date)

I attached our capacity-sizing template to make this easier (capacity-sizing-template.xlsx).

Next steps: if you can send answers by Friday, Marissa and Rafael will put together a recommended config and cost estimate. We can then schedule a 30-min tech-sizing call to validate assumptions.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
https://redwoodinference.com

[attachment: capacity-sizing-template.xlsx]

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmecloud.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up & sizing questions from today's call (Dedicated capacity)

Hi Connor — thanks for the clear list. Answers below (inline):

- Preferred GPU family: H100 if available. We prefer to standardize on H100 for new deployments, but can accept A100 if you note perf delta.
- TPS target: sustained 120 TPS across our primary text-generation endpoint; expected peak 300 TPS during launches.
- Concurrency: we typically see ~50 concurrent active generation requests; spikes up to ~150 for short bursts.
- Token mix: average request size is ~150 input tokens and ~200 generated tokens. ~10% of calls are long-form (>=1024 generated tokens).
- Request type breakdown: ~80% text generation, ~15% embeddings (batched), ~5% reranking.
- Models: initially using a 13B open model (we're evaluating a fine-tuned variant). Open to your recommendation for a production variant.
- Region/timeline: US-West primary; targeting production readiness by mid-September (Q3).

I've attached our internal risk assessment and a short notes doc. Also interested in SLA and pricing implications for H100 vs A100.

Best,
Samantha Lee
Head of ML Platforms | Acme Cloud
samantha.lee@acmecloud.com | +1 (650) 555-0133

[attachment: acme-risk-assessment.pdf]

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Follow-up & sizing questions from today's call (Acme Cloud)

Marissa / Rafael — forwarding Samantha's responses. Quick summary for sizing:
- Prefers H100, but can accept A100
- Sustained 120 TPS, peak 300 TPS; concurrency ~50 avg, bursts to 150
- Avg tokens: 150 in / 200 out; 10% long-form >=1024 tokens
- 80% gen, 15% embeddings (batched), 5% reranking
- Model: 13B fine-tuned variant (likely FP16 or quantized)
- Region: us-west; target mid-Sep production

Can you run a quick capacity recommendation and note any constraints for H100 allocation + autoscale/burst strategy? Also include an estimate for required KV cache sizing given 10% long-form and the 13B model. I'm happy to set up a short sync with infra if needed.

Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

> On Thu, Jun 11, 2026 at 09:34, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmecloud.com> wrote:
> > (see inline answers)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2026 16:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up & sizing questions from today's call (Dedicated capacity)

Hi Samantha — great, thanks for the fast answers and the risk doc. We've started a sizing draft and have a few proposed next steps:

1) Internal sizing: Marissa and Rafael will produce a recommended Dedicated pool with H100 baseline and an A100 fallback option, plus an autoscale profile for bursts to handle 300 TPS. Expect a preliminary estimate by Tuesday (15 Jun).

2) Tech-sizing call: Are you available Tue 16 Jun or Wed 17 Jun for a 30-min call with our infra/SEs to validate KV-cache assumptions and concurrency behavior? Proposed times:
   - Tue 16 Jun 10:00–10:30 PT
   - Wed 17 Jun 13:00–13:30 PT

3) Deliverables: scoped cost estimate (H100 vs A100), recommended instance counts, KV cache sizing (estimated GB), and a short runbook for burst autoscaling. We'll attach an updated sizing workbook (acme-dedicated-sizing-proposal.xlsx) and a short note on SLA tiers.

4) Procurement: if the config looks good we can follow our normal Dedicated procurement path (reserved capacity contract + onboarding). I'll add the HubSpot deal (HS-672849) link and start a DocuSign for the initial SOW if you want to expedite.

If one of the proposed times works, I'll send a calendar invite and include a lightweight agenda.

Thanks — looking forward to the call.

Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
